params.body:
## Why

On 9 November the trend page stopped showing the reading because a model wrote it and nobody read it before it went up. The Observatory now has that step: someone from the editorial team checks a trend, and the pipeline sends the checked reading with `checked_at` (Trendwolves/gentells-pipeline, `workbench/insight-check`). A checked trend can show its reading again; anything unchecked stays measured only.

## What

- Migration: `trend_cards.checked_at`.
- `Projection` keeps the reading's prose only when a valid `checked_at` comes with it, and fills the card `summary` from the checked "what's happening". Without it, the prose is dropped as before.
- `TrendCard::checkedReading()` returns the four parts only for a checked card, whatever the stored reading holds.
- Trend page: the four parts in the stone card under the headline row, laid out as before 9 November (Signal, Why it matters, The semiotic read, How to activate it; `**emphasis**` bold). The card in the trends list carries its summary again.
- Still off: "Read it together with" (links with their why), shift names and the names in the layers graph. A model wrote them and the check does not cover them.

## Tests

`TrendMeasuredOnlyTest`: a checked trend keeps and shows all four parts and its summary; an unchecked one shows none, including prose stored before. 714 of 715 pass; `BuildStampTest` needs a plain checkout and fails the same way on main in a worktree. Pint clean. Rendered locally with a checked and an unchecked trend.

## Order

Merge after the pipeline PR. Before that, nothing sends `checked_at`, so the site keeps showing measured trends only.
params.title: A trend someone from the editorial team checked shows its reading again
